v1_status: REJECTED; do not modify or relabel its result

reason.interpretation: Both weak cost-adjusted selection and insufficient opportunity density; simply increasing exposure or leverage is not justified. Rejection reasons overlap and are not causal ablation estimates.

trial_budget.changes_after_results: new experiment version; keep failed results
trial_budget.control_seeds: 0 through 199; historical eligible pool, identical execution/cost/risk policy; no future membership

common.universe: Historical top80 USDT spot by trailing30 mean quote volume, minimum1m USDT; 240 consecutive days; ended markets retained
common.market_gate: BTC prior completed daily close above SMA200; weekly/monthly context uses only completed bars
common.execution: D signal close, D+1 observation, earliest D+2 open; inherited gap rejection and stop-first execution
common.initial_stop: signal close minus2.5 ATR14; reject if distance outside3%..18%; size again at actual simulated execution
common.missing_held: full-loss writeoff when unobservable at close; no hindsight last-price liquidation
common.instrument: unborrowed spot; funding0; no leverage test until edge gates pass
common.classification: price proxies, not fundamental revaluation evidence

challenger_A.name: relative_strength_recovery
challenger_A.hypothesis: A recovery of relative strength after a sustained below-trend period identifies early repricing more efficiently than a narrow absolute56day range.

At least one close in last7 completed days crossed from below to above causal SMA50; latest close remains above SMA50
Latest close is10%..60% below trailing180day high
28day asset return minus BTC28day return is at least0.03
Asset7day return <=0.12 and28day return between0 and0.30
Mean true range of last10 days / mean true range of preceding30 days <=0.90
Latest completed weekly close is above preceding weekly close

challenger_A.exit: BTC market gate fails, or close below SMA50 after7days held, or84days held; weekly delayed plan
challenger_A.partial_profit: half at3 initial R; inherited stop-first convention

challenger_B.name: established_trend_controlled_pullback

chronology.selection_rule: Freeze both complete specs and code hashes before running. Evaluate both, retain both failures. Select at most one only if all gates pass; otherwise select none. No splicing winners across years.
chronology.warning: These periods were already inspected for v1; historical validation is not untouched OOS. A genuinely new forward paper interval of at least90days starts only after code freeze, without orders.

edge_gates_before_forward_paper.interpretation: Two challengers:97.5th percentile control hurdle is a conservative multiplicity-aware screen, not a proof of future profitability. Monthly blocks handle only part of dependence.

capital_growth_relevance_gates.interpretation: Economic research hurdle only:1% monthly on20m is200k, still far below5m. Even passing requires a capital-growth phase; it does not authorize withdrawals or leverage.

discarded: Multiplying v1 exposure or applying2x/3x leverage while stress expectancy is negative
Removing several v1 filters and selecting whichever historical variant looks best
Claiming a low-priced or compressed chart proves fundamental undervaluation
Treating historical monthly median0 as a dependable cashflow stream

fundamental_followup_if_both_fail.scope: A separate point-in-time catalyst dataset, not backfilled present-day fundamentals
